set -eu
mkdir -p /config
chown -R 568:568 /config
envsubst < /config-template/config.toml > /config/config.toml
chown 568:568 /config/config.toml
chmod 644 /config/config.toml

set -euo pipefail
cd typescript/server
export POSTGRES_URL="$${POSTGRES_URL}"
export SEEDS_DIR="../../db/seeds"
if [[ -z "$${SEEDS_COMMIT_HASH:-}" ]]; then
  SEEDS_COMMIT_HASH="$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo local)"
fi
export SEEDS_COMMIT_HASH
bun run src/scripts/load-seeds-pg.ts

if [ ! -f /tmp/worker-heartbeat ]; then exit 1; fi
HEARTBEAT=$(cat /tmp/worker-heartbeat)
NOW=$(date +%s)
AGE=$((NOW - HEARTBEAT))
if [ $AGE -gt 60 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit 0
